title: 剩余 6 项重新取证：1 项落地实现，5 项维持边界的独立裁定
verification: Read-only host evidence from MT MCP class outlines and searches over the exact OS4 carriers, plus read-only adb shell/root node and permission inspection on the connected SDK37 device. No chmod, no settings write, no kill, no service action, no sysfs write and no device feature action was executed.

evidence: SystemUI dex_field Lcom/miui/systemui/modulesettings/NavigationSettings;->HIDE_GESTURE_LINE:Landroid/net/Uri; built from Settings.Global.getUriFor("hide_gesture_line")
SystemUI dex_method Lcom/miui/systemui/SettingsManager;->onHideGestureLineChanged() reads MiuiSettings.Global.getBoolean(resolver, "hide_gesture_line")
SystemUI dex_field Lcom/android/systemui/statusbar/phone/NavigationModeControllerInjector;->mHideGestureLine:Z with 7 incoming xrefs
WMShell dex_method Lcom/android/wm/shell/multitasking/common/MultiTaskingSettingsObserver;->isGestureLineShowing()Z and onGestureLineChanged() reading the same key
real device: dumpsys package com.android.systemui shows android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS granted=true
real device: Settings.Global hide_gesture_line currently reads 0
Home.apk complete DEX name searches: NavStubView=0, RecentsContainer=0, isShowNavigationHandle=0, MiuixUIUtils=0
Home.apk only carries resource 0x7f090056 navigation_guide_hide_gesture_line_title and one GestureLine manifest reference
HyperCeiler upstream HideNavigationBar hooks launcher NavStubView/RecentsContainer, which no longer exist
homeLauncherUpstreamTarget.decision: Upstream launcher hook body rejected; mapped onto the native preference instead (see above).

evidence: SystemUI searches: statusbar_gestures=0, mGestureRec=0, GestureRecorder=0, mLogfile=0, gesture_recorder=0
framework wrapper search: statusbar_gestures=0, GestureRecorder=0
device filesystem: indexoff statusbar_gestures.dat at /sdcard, /sdcard/MIUI, /data/system all absent; find *gesture* under /data and /sdcard returns nothing
only gesturelog references are analytics sinks (SwipeUpGestureLogger with a LogBuffer field, LockscreenGestureLogger), not a file writer
gestureLogger.decision: Not implemented. No file to relocate and no file-writing method exists in the current carrier.

evidence: SystemUI qs_label matches only resource:0x7f071768, which is dimen qs_label_container_margin (10dp), not a label preference
SystemUI quick_settings_label=0
Settings.apk has no hide_navigation_bar string; gesture-line strings it does carry are for the navigation guide key
qsLabel.decision: Not implemented. Upstream key has no hook consumer; no user-visible behavior is defined by upstream code.

evidence: device: /dev/snd/pcmC0D* are mode 0660 system:audio u:object_r:audio_device:s0
device: init.svc.vendor.audio-hal-aidl running, init.svc.audioserver running
SystemUI DEX: SnowLeopard=0, snow_leopard=0, pcmC=0, audio.service=0 (no in-process carrier)
upstream SnowLeopardModeTile only kills the audio HAL and chmods nodes; it persists no owner/mode/selinux snapshot and restores a hard-coded 0660
snowLeopardAudio.decision: Not implemented. A process-local boolean cannot survive restart while nodes stay 000; a durable per-node snapshot/restore transaction with fail-closed behavior is still required.

evidence: device: /sys/class/backlight/panel0-backlight/brightness is -rw-r--r-- system:system; max_brightness -r--r--r-- system:system; actual_brightness -r--r--r-- root:root
device: max_brightness reads 16383; brightness read 932
device: /sys/class/mi_display/disp-DSI-0/brightness_clone -rw-rw-r-- system:system reads 855; max_brightness_clone -rw-rw-r-- system:system reads 16383
non-root shell reads are Permission denied
framework exposes only standard IDisplayManager/BrightnessChangeEvent brightness surfaces; no MIUI high/custom-brightness helper class was found
sunshineBrightness.decision: Not implemented. Upstream chmods to 777 and raw-writes Integer.MAX_VALUE with no accepted-range validation or persisted last brightness; a node contract (accepted range, snapshot/restore) is still required before either the high or custom row can ship safely.

implementedThisBatch.carrier: Settings.Global.hide_gesture_line written from the SystemUI process
implementedThisBatch.boundary: Writes only the single native global key on SystemUI application start; no sysfs, brightness, audio or navigation-mode writes; no overlap with the navigation_handle_custom drawing-interception card. Restore-on-disable is an explicit option (default on). Reconciles once per process start, so a later manual change is not re-overwritten.

pending: Sunshine high mode and custom brightness (verified node range + snapshot/restore).
